0022600112.text: The Los Angeles Lakers (2-0, 1st in the Pacific and 1st in the West) visit the Utah Jazz (1-1, 4th in the Northwest and 1 game back, 8th in the West) in the third game of the season for Los Angeles. Both of the Lakers' wins have come at home, while Utah is 1-0 at home and 0-1 on the road, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27. In 2025-26 the Lakers won the series 4-0, including a 131-107 win in Los Angeles on April 12, 2026. Out for the Lakers are Adou Thiero (knee, inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique, strain), while Utah will be without Jusuf Nurkic (foot, strain) and Trey Alexander (knee, bruise).
